summary: Backend critical flows passed; frontend signup, navigation, single mail, test mail, CSV upload, and preview passed. Bulk workflow is blocked after sending the campaign test email.

minor.issue: Rows without an @ are silently skipped rather than counted in invalid_count; invalid CSV entries are therefore under-reported.

integration_issues.issue: After POST /api/campaigns/{id}/test succeeds, UI sets step to 4 again, leaving the test recipient form visible and never rendering the confirmation button; campaign cannot be confirmed or sent.

action_items: Fix Bulk campaignTest state transition to the confirmation step after a successful test send (step 5).
Count all non-empty malformed CSV values in invalid_count while still excluding the header.
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend bulk state machine is inconsistent: campaignTest sets step 4 while confirmation is rendered only for step 5, blocking the core send flow.
seed_data_creation: Created uniquely named temporary test accounts and campaigns through public APIs/UI; no seeded data modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth, dashboard limit, single mail, dedicated test mail, CSV upload, preview, and backend gating/limit checks passed. Retest bulk test→confirm→send and malformed CSV invalid counts after fixes.
rca of the issue: In App.js Bulk.campaignTest(), the success handler calls setStep(4), but the confirmation UI is guarded by step===5. The backend correctly changes test_status to SENT, so this is a frontend state-transition defect. parse_recipients() continues when '@' is absent, causing malformed values to be omitted from invalid_count.
